---
title: "Data: email, messages, calls and radio"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("radoslaw-email-dataverse", "snap-collegemsg", "snap-email-eu-core-temporal", "nr-ia-enron-employees", "eventnet-rhem-data", "copenhagen-networks-study", "statnet-relevent-workshop", "fourpcan-alter-nominations", "networkdynamicdata-cran", "konect-dutch-college")
```

Directed messages between people in an organisation or community: email, instant messages, phone calls, police radio and nominations. These logs have strong repetition and reciprocity and, where the clock is known, daily and weekly cycles, which makes them the standard test bed for endogenous statistics and for time-shifted sampling of global covariates.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
